data.name: Heirloom
data.description: Heirloom is a U.S. Direct Air Capture pure-play that uses limestone-based solid sorbents to remove CO2 from the atmosphere. It operates North America's first commercial DAC facility in Tracy, California, and is building two additional DAC facilities at the Port of Caddo-Bossier in Northwest Louisiana, the second of which is Heirloom's contribution to the DOE-funded Project Cypress DAC Hub.
